scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible finite checks; no independent audit or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Brownian generator D Delta; absorbing point on half-line or exterior absorbing three-dimensional sphere only.
Reset radii independent and supported in a bounded interval separated from the absorber; initial position fixed across protocols.
Independent iid positive finite renewal times; instantaneous relocations; no state-dependent resets, moving absorber, or relocation costs.
The finite numerical checker does not establish the infinite/all-clock theorem.
Comparison with all possible unpublished or unindexed general convex-order/restart results is not proved exhaustive.
title: Sharp distributional optimization of renewal-reset Brownian search in one and three dimensions
